metadata.description: Claude Code skills for SEO teams and Keyword.com users — rank tracking, keyword research, and reporting workflows built on the Keyword.com MCP.

plugins.name: project-setup
plugins.description: Set up a Keyword.com rank-tracking project from a URL: crawl the site's pages and blog, distill product + content topics, expand into real MSV-backed keywords, and create the tagged project. Bundles the Keyword.com MCP.

plugins.name: agency-prospecting
plugins.description: End-to-end SEO prospect outreach: Apollo contact search + enrich → seed keyword from their site → white-labeled Keyword.com ViewKey report → personalized cold-email draft. Bundles the Keyword.com MCP; Apollo is added via Connectors.

plugins.name: ppc-savings
plugins.description: Quantify the equivalent Google Ads spend a site's organic rankings replace: CPC × estimated organic traffic for every top-ranking keyword in a Keyword.com project, totalled into a client-ready 'PPC savings' report. Bundles the Keyword.com MCP.
